messages:
alex: heads-up — seeing weird access behavior after last night's key rotation for the embeddings service. some requests that should be blocked by per-route scopes are succeeding.
sam: ugh. when did we rotate? which key/route?
jordan: alex can you paste an example request + route name? and attach logs if possible.
alex: repro case: route `emb-v1-autocomplete` is configured to allow only `embeddings.read` plus model constraints.
alex: request header looks normal: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX` and route param `route=emb-v1-autocomplete`, model: `open-embedding-1`.
alex: but the runtime is executing path `chat.generate` (??) and returns a 200 with tokens. logs show scope eval returned `ALLOW` due to fallback to a parent route policy.
carla: could this be the RBAC policy refactor we merged last week? iirc we introduced "scope grafting" so child routes inherit parent allowlists unless explicitly denied.
emily: we started seeing a few customer flags this morning about embeddings leakage into chat features. support ticket 3452.
nate: i pulled the audit logs — there's no KMS key_id recorded for these particular requests. looks like our audit schema omitted kms_metadata after the rotate endpoint change.
sam: timeline: rotation job started 1769780000, finished 1769783600. RBAC refactor merged 1769778000. possible race.
jordan: alex can you paste the small log snippet (redacted) showing the eval path? that will help.
alex: paste:
```
[2026-04-06T08:12:31Z] request_id=abc123 route=emb-v1-autocomplete model=open-embedding-1 token_count=24
policy_eval: matched parent_route_policy="/emb" result=ALLOW reason="inherited_allowlist: *"
runtime_exec: handler=chat.generate selected_model=open-embedding-1
```
carla: ohhh -- inherited_allowlist:"*" — that's the problem. parent route had a wildcard allow after the refactor.
nate: and because audit logs don't include KMS wrapping id, we can't correlate which rotated key was used for the token issuance; that's blocking root cause.
emily: customers seeing semantic drift: embeddings queries returned conversational text. bad.
sam: immediate mitigations:
- rollback RBAC refactor (if low friction) or revert the inherited wildcard behavior
- add a temporary hard deny for any route mismatch at runtime (route.allowed_operation != handler.operation -> 403)
- publish note to affected customers and rotate affected API keys again
jordan: agree on hard deny at runtime as hotfix. then roll back or patch refactor properly.
carla: i'll draft the runtime guard. quick pseudocode:
```
if route_policy.allowed_operations does not include handler.operation:
  return 403
```
alex: also need to patch audit schema to include `kms_key_id` and `key_rotation_id` fields — otherwise postmortem will be missing.
nate: i can add those to the audit payload and wire to KMS metadata. low-risk change.
deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-runtime/hotfix/guard-403 -> prod (canary)
deploy-bot: canary: 5% -> healthy
alex: after canary success, let's rotate the suspect keys again and mark old tokens revoked.
sam: assign owners: carla for runtime guard PR, nate for audit schema + KMS wiring, alex for key rotation coord + customer comms, jordan for postmortem draft.
carla: will open PR now, tag @eng-oncall for review.
nate: audit schema PR in review.
jordan: i'll start a short incident writeup with timeline and impact.
emily: i'll send the customer advisory draft to legal for sign-off, then post.
sam: good work. once hotfix is live, we'll run a targeted test suite to verify embeddings vs chat enforcement matrix (per-route x operation x model).
alex: one more ask — add metric/alert: count of requests where handler.operation != route.expected_operation. spike -> pager.
carla: added to dashboard board `security/ops` in next 15m.
alex: thanks all. follow-ups in thread.
